Title: Browser cybersecurity requirements
Scope and boundary: Standalone browsers; Annex III Class I. Detailed ETSI scope says stand-alone browsers.
Servo-drive applicability note: A drive's web UI/browser client does not by itself make the drive a browser product.

Title: Password manager cybersecurity requirements
Scope and boundary: Password managers for ICT common use; Annex III Class I.
Servo-drive applicability note: A drive login credential store is not automatically a password-manager product.

Title: Software searching for/removing/quarantining malicious software
Scope and boundary: Anti-malware/antivirus software as a product; Annex III Class I.
Servo-drive applicability note: Embedded malware scanning, if any, does not automatically turn a servo drive into an anti-malware product.

Title: Virtual Private Network (VPN) products
Scope and boundary: VPN-function products; scope explicitly excludes VPNs used in industrial OT; Annex III Class I.
Servo-drive applicability note: An industrial remote-access VPN gateway is a separate product boundary; drive Ethernet or remote maintenance capability is insufficient.

Title: Network Management Systems
Scope and boundary: NMS; scope explicitly excludes systems used in industrial OT; Annex III Class I.
Servo-drive applicability note: Servo commissioning/configuration software is not automatically an NMS.

Title: Security Information and Event Management systems
Scope and boundary: SIEM products; scope explicitly excludes systems used in industrial OT; Annex III Class I.
Servo-drive applicability note: Drive alarms/history are not themselves SIEM event collection, correlation and analysis products.

Title: Boot managers
Scope and boundary: Boot managers as Annex III Class I important products.
Servo-drive applicability note: A drive bootloader does not automatically make the drive a boot-manager product.
